name: Lydsyg

facts.text: Lydsyg is a level-58 named with 10,000 health; seven skuggande come with it.
It drains life and spreads a long Black Plague.
Allakhazam lists Lydsyg as magical, level 52-55; it drops skuggande wings.
Danish lyd means sound and syg sick: 'sound-sick' (to verify).

story: Where Dyranapur hums, Lydsyg sings, and its song is the sickness. It is something the skuggande made, or something they worship; the dwarves are not sure which. Its name in the old northern tongue means sick with sound, and anyone who has heard it close knows why: the drone gets into the teeth. It drains the life from whoever stands nearest and leaves a rot behind. The skuggande gather round it in the dark like a congregation, and fall silent only when it does.
legend: Lydsyg is a group named with seven skuggande. Same plan as Dyranapur: clear the bugs, cure the plague, keep healers back. It drops a good wing cloak and a hammer the healers like. Fight it away from the waterfall room or both swarms come.

lairEntry: A drone fills the cave. Your teeth ache.

briefing: lydsyg + 7 skuggande, same as the waterfall bug
rumour: heard lydsyg means sound-sick. [makes sense|my teeth hurt just hearing it]

loremasterTopic.text: The singing thing of the skuggande. Its name means sick with sound, and its drone gets into the teeth.
